cropping: Existing grid-localized 500-sample (2 s at 250 Hz) windows; no raw re-cut; zero-phase filtering uses the complete current stroke.
channels: Four stored channels; freshly checked acquisition table for all 63 development trial/REST recordings: map 0,1,2,3. Physical S0-S3 order follows documented tape order; no new anatomical inspection. No cyclic derotation.
filters: Third-order zero-phase Butterworth 0.5-12 Hz; per-window demeaning; lags 0,5,...,30; ridge 1e-6 times covariance trace; tangent features dimension 406.
duplicates: Unique recording/stroke identities freshly verified; no marked duplicate field in W02 archive.
overwrite_protection: Directory, log, preflight and exit file absent; exclusive log/preflight creation; runner mkdir(exist_ok=False); preserve incomplete runs.
test_access: Only development NPZ and development acquisition metadata read. Sealed W07/W10/W12 absent; no sealed NPZ or C170 data accessed. All nine development wears scored by leave-one-wear-out; exploratory.
epochs: Not applicable; logistic regression max_iter=3000, C=0.1; PCA=30; prior_count=3. No neural training or epoch selection.

seeds.model: Unmodified runner does not seed PCA (solver=auto, random_state=None); no exact numerical determinism claimed.

experiment: 98 real configuration/draw rows and 490 matched null rows; nine held-out wears per row; no derotation.
preprocessing: Population scaler/PCA/precision/model/global reference fit on eight complete training wears. Held-out anchor reference uses selected startup strokes; running reference uses preceding strokes only. NC4 scaler uses four anchors only. Training anchor records include their anchors in fitting; running training references use their full recording (deployment mismatch).
calibration_order: Chosen prefix strokes are treated as performed first; all other strokes scored in recording order. This reorders acquired prefix strokes when anchors occurred later. Not a literal replay of the original recording chronology.
null: Same recording-level class permutation applied to training labels and held-out anchor selection per seed; scored against true labels; seed-specific anchor removal can change scored identities.
